description: Returns a unique, stable id string for the component instance, safe for server rendering and hydration.
JSX name of the `for` attribute that links a `<label>` to an input by id.
Points to the id of an element whose text describes the field (hints, errors).
Root option (`createRoot`, `hydrateRoot`, server renderers) that prefixes generated ids when several React apps share a page.
Server HTML differs from the first client render, e.g. because of random ids. React reports it and may re-render.
